Sunderland v Chelsea (Kick-off 2.00pm). Coverage of the Premier League match from Stadium of Light. The hosts did the league double over their visitors last season thanks to two 2-1 victories. Sunderland scored a late winner at Stamford Bridge in the first game back in October thanks to a goal from Chemsdine Talbi in the 93rd minute as they came from a goal down. The reverse fixture at this ground in May then saw the Black Cats hold on to a 2-1 lead despite Cole Palmer's goal in the 56th minute.

Manchester United v Aston Villa (Kick-off 4.30pm). Coverage of the Premier League match from Old Trafford. The hosts won this meeting back in March last season thanks to a 3-1 victory which saw Casemeiro, Matheus Cunha and Benjamin Sesko all score in the second half to earn all three points. The reverse fixture back in December at Villa Park saw Morgan Rogers score a brace to give the Midlands club a 2-1 victory on home soil.
